title: SKE Crystal CL6000 Berry Medley Prefilled Vape Pod - 20mg
description: The SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Pack in Berry Medley offers a vibrant combination of rich, dark berry flavours. Sharp Blackcurrant and tangy Raspberry notes add a delicious fruity bite, softened by sweet, jammy Blueberry for balance and depth, creating an intriguingly complex yet instantly satisfying berry fruit vape. Each pack contains a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill container, designed exclusively for the SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Kit. Together, they provide up to 6000 puffs (depending on personal usage) of consistent flavour and vapour. The pods feature dual mesh coil technology for smooth draws, enhanced flavour, and reliable vapour production with every puff. An automatic refill mechanism and leak-resistant design make the system easy to use, ideal for both experienced and newer vapers. Preloaded with 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, the pod delivers rapid nicotine satisfaction and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit, tailored for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. Once the pod and refill container are empty, simply replace both to continue enjoying hassle-free, flavour-packed vaping.
